children: A three-day tour of BHP's Copper South Australia assets, starting Sunday, is expected "to present a credible path to provincial development," say Jefferies analysts. Jefferies expects a focus on the phasing of the proposed Olympic Dam smelter and refinery expansion, "with further supplementary information, including updated capex." There will also be a focus on Carrapateena concentrate production growth, it says. Jefferies has a hold rating and A$65.00/share target on BHP. Shares are up 1.4% at A$55.15.
